mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses the discount rate for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.5pp over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises by more than 0.3 percentage points in a single month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger a flight to safety, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of months where UNRATE increases by >0.3pp.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) by more than 1.5% month-over-month indicate a broad-based consumption slowdown, which predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both RSAFS and HOUST decline by >1.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO) below 100, supply chain disruptions and reduced manufacturing output signal an impending recession, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over the past 6 months indicates a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where GDPC1 has declined for 6 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points each month indicate a severe labor market contraction, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS decline > 0.5% MoM and UNRATE rise > 0.5pp MoM
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS declines by >0.5% MoM and UNRATE rises by >0.5pp MoM.

mechanism_narrative: In the context of a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE > 4.0%), the labor market deterioration accelerates equity sell-offs, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where UNRATE > 4.0.
